LanguageData.PhobosSling_LiftGizmoDesc: Choose a vehicle parked outdoors within {CELLS} cells to carry hanging from the cargo hook. Today the hook lifts up to {CAPACITY} kg, the vehicle, its cargo and the people aboard together. When the helicopter takes off, the vehicle goes with it, and it is set down beside the helicopter where it lands.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_CancelGizmoDesc: Unhook {LOAD} and take off without it.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_NoHook: It has no cargo hook. A mechanic can fit one in the fittings and tunes.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_NoSlingSet: It has no sling set aboard. Load one, made at the vehicle parts bench.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_TooHeavy: {LOAD} weighs {WEIGHT} kg with what it carries, and the hook lifts {CAPACITY} kg today.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_LaunchWaitsForCrew: {LOAD} still waits for someone to hook it up.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_ChosenCrew: {HELICOPTER} will lift {LOAD} once a colonist has hooked it up.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_ChosenReady: {HELICOPTER} has {LOAD} on its hook and will lift it at take-off.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_LeftBehind: {LOAD} was not hooked up and stays behind.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_NoSpot: There is no clear open ground near the helicopter to set {LOAD} down on. It stays on the hook until there is.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_InspectHooked: On the hook: {LOAD}, {WEIGHT} kg of {CAPACITY} kg today ({SHARE})
LanguageData.PhobosSling_InspectAwaitingCrew: Waiting for someone to hook it up.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_SettingHeatDesc: A helicopter's cargo hook lifts 1% less for each degree above 15 °C, at most 30% less, as thinner hot air gives the rotor and engines less to work with. Off, a hook lifts its rated load in any weather.
LanguageData.PhobosSling_SettingCrew: A ground crew hooks the load up
LanguageData.PhobosSling_SettingCrewDesc: A colonist walks to the chosen vehicle and hooks the strops on before the helicopter can lift it. Off, the helicopter hooks it up by itself.
